capstones.name: QIQTH.WedgeKMSToGR.qiqt_gr_freefield_complete
capstones.claim: For the explicit free Klein-Gordon field, the Einstein field equations follow from the QIQT-H entropy/heat law with all geometric and field-regularity inputs discharged, leaving only the labelled physical hypotheses below.
capstones.scope: This certifies a CONDITIONAL mathematical entailment (if the listed hypotheses, then the equations), kernel-checked and axiom-free. It does NOT assert that GR is physically true of our universe, nor that these Lean definitions faithfully model QIQT-H / GR (an adequacy judgment left to the reader via the rendered statement).

capstones.name: QIQTH.A1R6PublicClaim.a1_R6_public_claim
capstones.claim: For a smooth Riemannian metric that is flat and geodesically-normal to second order at a point, the heat kernel's Seeley-DeWitt coefficient a_1 equals R/6 at that point (the standard heat-kernel expansion coefficient, here recovered by an explicit truncated-Duhamel/Levi-parametrix construction) -- PROVIDED a package of roughly 65 chart-regularity, measurability, and analytic-convergence hypotheses (the honest residue below) all hold. This is a definitional re-export of `CapstoneExistentialAssembly.a1_R6_assembled_v3` (same statement; two outer binders renamed only to avoid a claim-card annotation collision), published as a stable, non-internal application so the tower has a citable name outside its own construction chain.
capstones.scope: This certifies a CONDITIONAL mathematical entailment ONLY: IF all ~65 listed hypotheses hold (most are routine chart/measurability/convergence regularity, but three families -- the truncated-Duhamel identity `core`, the C^2-facade convexity bundles `chart/source/derivData/env`, and the Levi/Duhamel analytic-residue block -- are the load-bearing analytic content, referred to campaign-wide as {hDuhamel, hDConv, hCConv}), THEN a_1 = R/6 at the origin for that metric. It does NOT assert a_1 = R/6 unconditionally, does NOT assert this holds for a general (non-flat-at-the-point) metric, and is NOT a statement about physical spacetime -- it is a single local Riemannian heat-kernel coefficient identity, one input among several in the QIQT-H -> GR chain, not the GR capstone itself. Kernel-checked and axiom-free like the entry above; the adequacy of the Lean formalization (does `heatOp`/`trueHeatKernel`/`vanVleckGatedWitness` faithfully model the heat kernel and Van Vleck determinant construction) is a human judgment left to the reader via the rendered statement, same as the GR entry's caveat (2).

_input_notes: Annotations for prop-hypothesis binders by exact name or by prefix (longest match wins). 'role' is purely descriptive: 'physical-input' = a load-bearing assumption that is the honest residue; 'regularity'/'setup' = routine. Unannotated prop binders are reported as '(assumption — see source)'.
